description: Exact raw scratch log bytes, independently matched to each existing result receipt. Failed, successful and empty logs remain separate. Base64 protects original byte hashes from Git newline conversion.
limits: Packaging verifies stored bytes against recorded receipt hashes, not continuous process/runtime provenance or the truth of every line. Existing start/result/provenance receipts retain their own scope and limitations. No test or gate was rerun by this collector.

decoding.algorithm: Buffer.from(entry.bytesBase64, 'base64'); require length === entry.byteLength and SHA-256 === entry.sha256 === entry.receiptLogSha256. Write bytes directly, not through shell text redirection.
decoding.collectorRecovery: Decode collector.bytesBase64 to a new .mjs file using a byte-preserving writer; verify collector.sha256. --decode uses the repository cwd and needs no scratch logs. Regeneration additionally requires original logs beside the collector.
